sloka: अतिकायो ऽपि तेजस्वी राक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्तदा।आरुरोह रथश्रेष्ठं श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम् ।। ६.६९.२५ ।।
transliteration: atikāyo 'pi tejasvī rākṣasendrasutastadā।āruroha rathaśreṣṭhaṁ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām ।। 6.69.25 ।।

translations.english: Then Atikaya the very bright son of Rakshasa king, foremost of all archers mounted on the best of chariots.
